clusters.desc: MCPServer advertises all capabilities unconditionally instead of filtering them to only those backed by registered primitives. Both PRs add an identical `capability_filter` parameter (same name, same type signature `Callable[[types.ServerCapabilities], types.ServerCapabilities] | None`) stored as `self._capability_filter`. (2 PRs)
